BiblicalUsage: Platos is breadth, width. Paul prays we may comprehend the breadth and length and depth and height of Christ's love in Ephesians 3:18, and the new Jerusalem is as long as it is broad in Revelation 21:16. The armies of Gog and Magog go up on the breadth of the earth in Revelation 20:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the breadth of God's love is wider than I can measure, and the breadth of the earth is not wide enough to hide from Him.
